notes: Search boxes on History and My collection: type a name, set, number, grade or cert number to find a card.
Grades lean lower (safer): the chances can lower the big PSA number but never raise it. When they lean higher, it says so.
Closer to PSA on Roger's cracked slabs: back edges are judged like back corners, and when a card's edge blends into the background its centering isn't counted against the grade.
A warning sign from the card checks (like a back colour that isn't a real card's) now shows at the top of the result.
Phone photos stop at PSA 9 (a photo can't show what a 10 needs; a scan can), and a card graded on the phone shows its photos in History, Details.
A blurry scan widens the range and says so. Chinese gem pack numbers (02 07/07) are read. Saved cards show where their scan files are.
Friend keys: Cardwright Pro for good.
